bullets: Vermis added max-health damage every third basic attack on one hero, and Serration added 3.5% of missing health, so focused targets melted faster as they dropped.
Every shot set off Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds and Sky Splitter, and Imperator made her critical strikes deal 30% more damage.
Inner Fury added 2 volleys and a 5-arrow fan to Inner Fire, and Breach cut physical armor by 35% for 4s for her follow-up attacks.
Seek and Destroy, Sticky Mine and Tesla Dome hit areas, so each cast set off Combustion on several heroes, and Wraith Leggings added 12% below 40% health.
Soulbinder adds 8% from 1450+ range and Eviscerate adds 15% on targets above 80% health, so long-range openers on healthy enemies hit hardest.
Takedowns gave Tainted Scepter 15 Malice stacks at once and Dominance healed 100 plus 15% missing health, so Gadget could keep casting after each kill.
Tranquility's heal triggered Exarch, Everbloom and Preservation together: allies got 10% attack speed, 5% damage mitigation and 20 Tenacity, and his own healing received grew 10%.
Delayed Fate turned 20% of ability damage into a 3s DoT, giving Tranquility's heal and 10% Damage Mitigation time to land on top of it.
45 ability haste brought Crash Bang Boom! back in about 58.6s; Percussive Tear shreds 2.5% armors per hit, and Thunk's stun sets off Dynamo's 8%.
